messages:
Platform Ops Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'eu-west-1-dedicated-2' scaling stalled — CPU pressure + pending queue growing for model 'rw-large-v2' (svc: dedicated-inference). Autoscale attempts 3/3 failed in last 2m.
Alex K: acked. I'm on it. seeing spike from a single customer? any traffic pattern?
Rachel M: also getting paged, joining now. metrics -> 95th latency jumped to 3.1s and error rate up to 2.6% for the pool.
Greg (SRE): @Alex K can you confirm autoscaler logs? last push was an update to the scale-policy two days ago.
Alex K: pulling logs, running `kubectl -n inference get hpa dedicated-eu-west-2 -o yaml` now.
Platform Ops Bot: autoscaler events: `FailedGetResourceMetricValue: unable to get metrics for resource requests.cpu` repeated.
Alex K: looks like the metrics server for that k8s node group is intermittently failing to report; autoscaler sees zero usable nodes and declines to scale.
Jen I (Infra): I'm seeing temporary IAM errors toward cloud autoscale API around the same time window (12:02–12:05 UTC). Could be control-plane throttling.
Rachel M: customer impact: CS Lina says two customers reported degraded responses, one (AcmeLabs) on dedicated pool with live traffic.
CS Lina: AcmeLabs reported slow responses and some 503s for their /v1/chat endpoint. They're on a hard SLA. They are already ACD-ing our status page.
Alex K: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable burst_capacity override on pool to allow warm nodes to serve beyond autoscale limits, 2) apply emergency per-tenant rate-limits for heavy users, 3) route non-critical load to hosted fallback. Doing step 1 now.
Alex K: running control-plane toggle: `POST /admin/pools/eu-west-1-dedicated-2/toggles` payload `{ "burst_capacity": true, "burst_duration_seconds": 600 }`
Platform Ops Bot: toggle accepted, burst_capacity: enabled for pool eu-west-1-dedicated-2 (will expire in 10m).
Greg (SRE): confirm you're also increasing the max_nodes temporarily? otherwise burst helps but may not relieve pressure if all nodes saturated.
Alex K: bumping pool max_nodes from 40 -> 60 for emergency window. `PATCH /admin/pools/... {"max_nodes":60}` -> accepted.
Jen I (Infra): since autoscaler can't read metrics, manual node scale will be used by infra: provisioning 10 extra nodes (expected add ~90s).
Rachel M: applying per-tenant quota cap for suspected noisy tenant: `rate_limit.update(tenant_id=org-879, qps=2)` to throttle their burst.
CS Lina: letting AcmeLabs know we enabled mitigations and routing fallback — they'll confirm if experience improves.
Platform Ops Bot: routing policy change: spillover enabled to hosted-api for request classes: best-effort, batch; critical customer pinned to dedicated still.
Alex K: monitoring — seeing queue length drop within 45s, latency trending down to 1.0s 95th for the pool. errors back to baseline.
Greg (SRE): keep logs of all toggles for postmortem. tag all actions with `incident/2799994321` in audit.
Jen I (Infra): nodes ready in 120s, infra reports cloud provider CPU capacity allocated.
Rachel M: good, I'll stay on to monitor for 15 more mins then hand off. Alex, can you prepare a short incident note for handoff?
Alex K: copying timeline + actions to thread: `- 12:02 alert triggered; 12:03 autoscale failures; 12:04 burst_capacity enabled; 12:05 max_nodes bumped; 12:07 infra added nodes; 12:08 queue reduced; 12:12 errors resolved`
CS Lina: customers notified: AcmeLabs + two others via CS. No credit decisions yet, awaiting postmortem.
Greg (SRE): next steps for follow-up: 1) check why metrics server returned errors -> correlate with IAM throttling, 2) add fallback in autoscaler control path to rely on node-level metrics if k8s metrics API down, 3) run tabletop for dedicated burst policy.
Rachel M: handing off to Greg for overnight watch. Greg, you have the pager at 12:20 UTC. I'll update the incident channel if anything changes.
Greg (SRE): taking pager. If anything regresses re-enable burst for the other pools as needed. Also will open a postmortem ticket and assign owners for infra, autoscale, and product communications.
Platform Ops Bot: INCIDENT: status= mitigated -> monitoring. incident_tag=incident/2799994321.
Alex K: final note: no data plane compromise, just control-plane/autoscale visibility. We'll keep burst toggles and manual max_nodes changes documented but aim to fix autoscaler resiliency so manual interventions aren't needed.
Rachel M: thanks all — nice quick coordination. :thumbsup:
